prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Pasadena, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1086; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you reported in Pasadena, Texas. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just go by my first name for now, if that's okay.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where you were driving when the collision happened?

A: I was heading down the main road toward a shopping center, and I was turning left into the parking lot entrance.

Q: What was the traffic like at the time?

A: It was fairly light. There was one car coming the other way, and I think it was stopped at the light a little ways back.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: Not really. I looked, saw the oncoming car, and started my turn. The next thing I knew there was a loud bang and my car was spinning a bit.

Q: Where did the other vehicle strike your car?

A: On the driver's side, toward the back. I felt it in my whole body.

Q: Did you receive any medical attention after the collision?

A: Yes, an ambulance took me to the hospital. They said my left wrist was fractured. I have a cast on it now and I'm taking it easy.

Q: Have you seen a doctor since then?

A: Yes, I've had two follow-up appointments and I'm scheduled for another next week.

Q: Is there anything you would like to add to your statement?

A: Just that I want to make sure the report is accurate about the timing of the light. I'm telling you what I remember, and I'm happy to answer anything else.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
